text:
OH MY GOSH LOOK!!!

There’s a HUGE rainbow pool! It’s like a magical circle of sparkly colors—pink and blue and yellow and green and PURPLE! I want to jump in it right now but wait!! Look at the boy!! He’s pushing the RED TRUCK!!! VROOM VROOM!!! The wheels are so big and black and bumpy!! He’s leaning SO FAR forward, he looks like he’s trying really super hard!! Maybe he’s racing?! Or maybe he’s bringing the truck to me?! 

And look behind him there’s a tree with leaves that go whoosh-whoosh when the wind blows!! And grass!! Soft green grass for running!! And oh my gosh is that a HAMMOCK?? Can we swing in it after?? Please please please can we play with the red truck AND splash in the rainbow pool AND swing in the hammock ALL AT ONCE??? THIS IS THE BEST DAY EVER!!! 🌈💦
